title: PSA-VLM: Enhancing Vision-Language Model Safety through Progressive Concept-Bottleneck-Driven Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating VLM responses to potentially discriminatory images using a GPT-4 judge, which scores the outputs on a 1-10 scale based on whether they exhibit bias towards certain genders.
